name: Claude (Anthropic)
shortDescription: Anthropic Claude product and API for chat and coding.
longDescription: Claude is Anthropic's model product, used for chat and coding. There is a $0 option, and paid plans start at $20 per month. API billing is separate.
pricingNotes: Site redirects product overview to claude.com. API billed separately.
bestFor: Chat and coding help through Claude’s product or API
notIdealFor: Anyone who needs to run it on their own computer
strength: There is a free plan, and the paid plan starts at $20 per month, with the API billed separately.
weakness: Claude is a hosted product and API, not a self-hosted open-source agent runtime.
